why_lead: Gold and silver replace Tesla as the lead. Tesla already led on 12, 17, 24 and 25 March, and its 'back in charge' and $2,600 evidence was already used in the 17 and 26 March items; the one new Tesla development (the 29-30 March protest day) is a protest story and moves to a smaller trade. Gold has not led before and has the strongest card moves with fresh attention: gold up 8.36% and silver up 10.97% over 20 sessions, GDX up 14.73%, a record move above 3,100 dollars, and dated 27-30 March attention items (the WSJ 'everyone is a gold bug' headline, silver-ETF flows, gold-token volumes). The attention changed from price to crowding, so the trade is a new angle rather than a repeat of the 17, 19 and 24 March gold smallers.
why_smaller: CoreWeave is new since every earlier edition: an IPO priced at 40 dollars with Nvidia as anchor, a flat debut and one close, so it repeats no earlier angle.
Reddit is new: the Bloomberg dip-buyer headline of 28 March and the 33.42% 20-session fall are not in any earlier retail trade.

Tesla returns as a smaller trade with a changed story: the 29 March global day of action (hundreds of locations) and the viral Walz row are new since the 12 March boycott lead and the 26 March smaller; the Musk-back and $2,600 angle is dropped.
